summary.text: Michelle Axtman is a Republican state senator from North Dakota who has represented District 7 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a U.S. Air Force Academy graduate who has served in the Air Force and Air Force Reserve.

paragraphs.text: Axtman earned a B.S. in geospatial science from the U.S. Air Force Academy in 2009 and an M.S. in project management from the University of Mary in 2013.
She has served in the U.S. Air Force and U.S. Air Force Reserve and has reached the rank of major.
Axtman assumed office in the North Dakota State Senate on December 1, 2022, succeeding Nicole Poolman.
Ballotpedia lists her as vice chair of the Senate Workforce Development Committee for 2023-2024.
She advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
